name: jira-mcp
description: MCP server for Jira Server/Data Center — research and analysis tools over Jira, authenticated with a Personal Access Token. Runs with zero dependencies, or as a standalone Windows executable.

scripts.test: node test/validate-plugin.mjs && node test/run-tests.mjs && node test/run-config-tests.mjs && node test/run-launcher-tests.mjs

comment: Dependencies are optional. The server ships with a bundled dependency-free MCP/stdio implementation in lib/ and uses the official SDK only when it is present. See README 'Install' for the no-npm and no-Node paths.
